meta.title: Paula Magdy — Software Engineer
meta.description: Paula Magdy is an AWS-certified full-stack software engineer in Cairo, Egypt, with production experience across TypeScript (Next.js/NestJS), PHP (Laravel), and Python (Django/Flask) on AWS, Azure, and Huawei Cloud.

work.label: SELECTED WORK
work.intro1: A short list of platforms I've shipped end-to-end —
work.introEmph: from API design and database schemas to AWS infrastructure and CI/CD.

r1.b1: Challenge Group is an AWS/Huawei Cloud partner delivering production platforms for government and enterprise clients across Egypt, KSA, and the UAE. Contributed to multiple production platforms as part of cross-functional Agile delivery teams.
r1.b2: Developed backend services for government and enterprise platforms serving 5,000+ concurrent users — domain-driven NestJS modules and Laravel APIs over PostgreSQL/Prisma and MySQL — applying targeted indexing and query tuning that cut API latency by ~35% under production load.
r1.b3: Hardened API layers alongside the backend team with Sanctum/JWT authentication, RBAC, attribute-based routing, self-validating DTOs, and structured request validation across multiple products.
r1.b4: Implemented transactional product workflows, including a request-and-bid marketplace flow with escalation handling and an in-app wallet supporting Paymob payments and withdrawals.
r1.b5: Delivered real-time and messaging capabilities with the feature team: WebSocket chat (Laravel Reverb), voice/SMS via Twilio, FCM push notifications, S3-backed media storage, and bilingual (EN/AR) content.
r1.b6: Contributed Next.js/React interfaces — onboarding and results-entry flows, role-based admin panels (Filament/Livewire), and live-updating leaderboards — to a shared, responsive component set maintained across the team.
r1.b7: Provisioned and maintained cloud infrastructure with the DevOps team on AWS (VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, Secrets Manager) and Azure (API Management).
r1.b8: Helped move the team to container-first CI/CD — Docker → ECR → ECS via CodeBuild/CodePipeline — reducing deployment time from ~20 minutes to under 5.
r1.b9: Automated customer-support conversations with a serverless Amazon Lex chatbot on AWS Lambda, integrated with Twilio, cutting manual triage for the support team.
r1.b10: Instrumented services with CloudWatch monitoring and structured logging, and maintained automated test coverage with Pest, PHPUnit, Jest, and Vitest.

r2.b1: Completed a government-sponsored, intensive software-engineering program (~1,200 hours) spanning full-stack development, system design, and cloud deployment.
r2.b2: Built full-stack applications across two backend ecosystems — Node.js/Express and Python (Django, Flask) — with React front-ends, secure REST APIs, structured authentication flows, and role-based access control.
r2.b3: Modeled both relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases, applying normalization and indexing to keep queries efficient as datasets grew.
r2.b4: Containerized services with Docker and deployed to AWS, applying system-design fundamentals and working in Agile sprints from design through delivery.

r3.b1: Built and shipped a production-ready e-commerce storefront in React — a responsive, cross-device UI wired to REST APIs for the product catalog and cart.
r3.b2: Architected a reusable component library with centralized state via React's Context API, removing prop-drilling and keeping catalog and cart state consistent as the product range and traffic grew.
r3.b3: Improved rendering performance and cut page-load times through render optimization and efficient asset loading, keeping large product listings smooth as the catalog scaled.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.a1: Paula Magdy is a full-stack software engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 3+ years of experience. An AWS Certified Solutions Architect, he builds production web platforms with cross-functional teams across frontend, backend, cloud, and DevOps — contributing across data modeling, API design, CI/CD, monitoring, and security.
faq.q2: What technologies does Paula Magdy work with?
faq.a2: He builds with Next.js, React, and TypeScript on the frontend; Node.js, NestJS, and Express, plus Laravel (PHP) and Django/Flask (Python) on the backend; PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Prisma ORM for data; and AWS, Azure, Huawei Cloud, Docker, and CI/CD for cloud and delivery.
faq.a3: At Challenge Group — an AWS/Huawei Cloud partner serving government and enterprise clients across Egypt, KSA, and the UAE — he has contributed to multiple production platforms as part of cross-functional Agile delivery teams: backend services for platforms serving 5,000+ concurrent users, transactional workflows including a request-and-bid marketplace and an in-app Paymob wallet, real-time chat and messaging, Next.js/React interfaces and role-based admin panels, AWS and Azure infrastructure with container-first CI/CD, and a serverless Amazon Lex support chatbot.
faq.q4: Where is Paula Magdy based, and is he open to remote work?
faq.a4: He is based in Cairo, Egypt, and is open to full-stack engineering roles and consulting engagements, including remote work.
faq.q5: What certifications does Paula Magdy hold?
faq.a5: He holds the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certifications, plus Huawei's HCCDP-Solution Architectures and HCCDA-Tech Essentials — alongside a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Information Systems from October 6 University.
faq.q6: How can I get in touch with Paula Magdy?
faq.a6: You can reach him by email at paulamagdy665@gmail.com or through the contact form on this site — he typically replies within 24 hours.
